# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

**Where your working files go — everything you produce is filed under the task it was produced for.** The rule is `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Memories/Laws/Tasks.md` (the task law); read it before creating or moving anything. Also read `/Volumes/Data/Temps/Harness/Outputs/Private/Skills/` for durable workflow references.

If a rule in `Constitution.md` conflicts with anything in this repo, the rule wins.
